raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: scorec
  version: "4.2.1"
  build: 1
  sha256: d0efdee5c60807117ace142336d6a26e65f9bcb54d535e6778a72b9778b5d08d
  # mpi is intentionally NOT set here -- it must come from the variant config
  # (recipe/conda_build_config.yaml's `mpi: [mpich]` default, overridden per
  # build by .ci_support/*.yaml) so the mpich/openmpi build matrix actually
  # takes effect. Declaring it in context: would shadow the variant value
  # with this fixed default on every build, silently ignoring the matrix --
  # confirmed via a real rattler-build --render-only test.
  mpi_prefix: ${{ "mpi_" + mpi }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/SCOREC/core/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: ${{ sha256 }}
  - git: https://github.com/SCOREC/pumi-meshes.git
    target_directory: pumi-meshes

build:
  number: ${{ build }}
  string: ${{ mpi_prefix }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build }}
  # osx-arm64 + openmpi used to be skipped here. The cause was this recipe's own
  # build.sh passing mpicc/mpicxx as CMAKE_C_COMPILER/CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER:
  # openmpi's wrappers are real compiled binaries (mpich's are portable shell
  # scripts), so under the osx-arm64 cross-compile (built from an osx-64 host)
  # CMake tried to execute a target-arch mpicxx on the build machine and died
  # with "mpicxx: Bad CPU type in executable" during compiler identification.
  # build.sh now passes the ordinary conda cross-compilers plus mpi.h/-lmpi
  # explicitly, so nothing target-arch has to run at build time and the skip is
  # no longer needed. SCOREC does not require an MPI wrapper: it has no
  # find_package(MPI) and never links MPI itself.
  skip:
    - win

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - git-lfs
    - cmake
    - make
  host:
    - ${{ mpi }}
    - metis
    - parmetis
    - zoltan
  run:
    - ${{ mpi }}
    - metis
    - parmetis
  run_exports:
    - ${{ name }} * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*

tests:
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then:
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/zoltan.h

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: The SCOREC Core is a set of C/C++ libraries for unstructured mesh simulations on supercomputers.
  homepage: https://www.scorec.rpi.edu/software.php

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - davidbrochart
    - SylvainCorlay
    - zhang-alvin
    - cekees
    - jhcollins
